title: Systemic / structural
description: Risks that emerge through institutions, incentives, concentration, and social systems.

title: Malicious use
description: Risks created when people intentionally use capable AI systems to cause harm.

title: Accidents / malfunctions
description: Risks created by system failures, brittle behavior, and unintended operation.

title: Misalignment
description: Risks created when a system’s learned objectives or behavior diverge from human intent.

title: Security / governance
description: Risks shaped by control, oversight, access, deployment, and institutional coordination.
